Jasmine / team —

Recommendation from Finance: issue a formal credit memo that references INV-3421 and SOW-2117. Rationale:
- Credit memos provide a clean audit trail and map neatly to contra-revenue GL accounts; offsets on open invoices can obscure collections aging and create reconciliation noise.
- For tax reporting, a credit memo with a negative line item allows us to reverse tax collected on the original invoice cleanly — important for states where sales tax was charged.

Operational notes:
- Please confirm the exact credit amount (Seedling indicated $12,000).
- Use reason code PROMO-TRIAL-2028 and map to GLA 4200-CONTRA (we'll provide exact GLA).
- If Seedling prefers their account to be credited (applied to next invoice) after issuance, Accounting can hold the credit on account for up to 90 days.

Attaching: credit_memo_workflow.xlsx (stub).

Marcus
VP, Finance Operations
